contradictions.description: register_document executes before the only canonical final DocumentManifest can be constructed, yet the provisional registry requires all of that final artifact's required fields.
The workflow binds NodeInvocation and ResultEnvelope, but no contract maps them to source bytes, initial registration state, DocumentRegistration, artifact IDs, or receipts.
Durable source persistence, registry projection, effect, receipt, and ledger ownership are not assigned across K01, D03, and the workflow caller.
The manifest-owned python component root has no authorized projection or adapter into the installable src runtime used by the workflow executor_ref.

classification.not_fail_reason: All behavior currently definable inside K01 passes; no resolving implementation is authorized for the contradictory shared contract.
classification.not_blocked_reason: No external resource or host capability is unavailable.
